articles.summary: 09/08/26 Simpson Strong-Tie to Unveil New Software and Equipment Solutions at 2026 Building Component Manufacturers Conference Simpson Strong-Tie, the leader in engineered structural connectors and building solutions, will introduce several new products and demo its lineup of component software and equipment during this year’s Building Component Manufacturers Conference (BCMC), September 14–18 in Columbus, Ohio. During the show, attendees can browse products, experience live demonstrations and meet with Simpson Strong-Tie specialists at Booth 901. They also can schedule personalized software demonstrations in advance here. “With cutting-edge equipment, innovative technology options and an extensive range of hardware, Simpson Strong-Tie offers component manufacturers a package of solutions for every stage of the job,” said Josh Fitzgerald, vice president – Component Manufacturing for Simpson Strong-Tie. “We’re looking forward to connecting with customers and potential customers at BCMC to explore how we can help streamline their business and boost efficiencies.” Software Solutions Simpson Strong-Tie will showcase new software solutions and demo many others, including: • CS® Cornerstone™ Wall: The new all-in-one platform combines building modeling with structural wood component design and analysis, powered by hsbcad. • CS Cloud Director™: The new cloud-based management platform is designed to improve visibility, streamline operations and support profitability. • CS Producer™: This cutting-edge, cloud-based truss production management software gives floor and roof truss manufacturers powerful ways to schedule and manage daily operations. • Demo suite: Attendees also can visit the Simpson Strong-Tie demo suite for a personal tour of CS Truss Studio™, CS Director™, CS EWP Studio™ and the iStruct® software suite. “Our cloud-native portfolio of component software and differentiated services uniquely positions us to help the construction industry lead its next era of productivity, precision and scalable growth,” said Chief Technology Officer Udit Mehta. “As part of our commitment to customers, partners and the broader industry, we continue to accelerate investments in AI, digital solutions and modernized platforms, helping customers deliver higher-quality products faster and with improved accuracy, greater consistency and more efficient execution.” Fabrication Equipment in Action Explore new and innovative equipment, including: • Expanded truss fabrication equipment line: Roof, floor and jack truss gantry tables; vertical stackers; finish rollers; and exit conveyors. • Monet DeSauw™ DeSawyer: Fully computerized, five-bladed truss saw. • EasyFrame™ automated marking saw (updated): Our upgraded platform combines precision cutting, automated printing, advanced routing capabilities and software integration into a single production system that improves throughput, accuracy and operational efficiency. Code-Listed Hardware Solutions Explore the latest Simpson Strong-Tie connectors, fasteners, anchors and component hardware, and talk with our team about solutions for your operation. Happy Hour Join the Simpson Strong-Tie team for happy hour on Wednesday, September 16, from 6 p.m. to 9 p.m. at Stories on High rooftop bar. Stop by the booth for details. As part of its continued investment in the component manufacturing industry, Simpson Strong-Tie recently broke ground on a new facility in Fulton, Missouri, that will bring together its equipment solutions business, including Monet DeSauw saws, EasyFrame™ automated marking systems and truss fabrication equipment. Building on the company’s established manufacturing presence in Fulton, the facility will consolidate its equipment solutions operations into a single location, enhancing the company’s ability to innovate, manufacture and support equipment solutions that help customers improve productivity, efficiency and quality while meeting the evolving needs of their businesses. For more information, visit www.strongtie.com.
articles.title: Simpson Strong-Tie to Unveil New Software and Equipment Solutions at 2026 Building Component Manufacturers Conference

articles.summary: 09/01/26 Simpson Strong-Tie Donates $25,000 for Wildfire Relief and Recovery in Washington and Canada Following the recent wildfires in Eastern Washington and across Canada, Simpson Strong-Tie has donated $25,000 toward relief, recovery and rebuilding efforts in both regions. The donations comprise $15,000 to the Innovia Foundation in Washington and $10,000 to the Canadian Red Cross. Innovia Foundation is a community foundation serving Eastern Washington and Northern Idaho. The nonprofit’s Spokane Complex Wildfire Response Fund is supporting immediate relief efforts as well as long-term recovery and rebuilding needs for individuals and families impacted by the multiple fires this summer. Funds for the Canadian Red Cross will go toward the Canadian Wildfire Fund in support of immediate response and long-term recovery. The Fund is also used to enhance readiness and response to escalating wildfire risks. “Our hearts continue to go out to all of those impacted by the wildfires across Washington and Canada this summer, our own customers among them,” said Simpson Strong-Tie President and CEO Mike Olosky. “The work that the Innovia Foundation and the Canadian Red Cross are doing to provide relief now, and in the months and years to come, is critically important, and we’re grateful to be able to contribute to those efforts.” Along with the initial donation, Simpson Strong-Tie will match employee donations made to either organization. Simpson Strong-Tie employees impacted by the wildfires can also request grant assistance through the company’s Simpson Strong-Tie Team Member Relief Fund. The wildfire relief donations are part of the company’s ongoing commitment to aid in disaster relief and recovery efforts around the world. To donate, visit https://innovia.org and www.redcross.ca.
articles.title: Simpson Strong-Tie Donates $25,000 for Wildfire Relief and Recovery in Washington and Canada

articles.summary: 09/15/26 Simpson Strong-Tie and hsbcad Bring Advanced Wall-Framing Technology to CS Cornerstone™ Wall Software New wall-framing solution will be showcased alongside Simpson Strong-Tie® Component Solutions® software and equipment at BCMC 2026 PLEASANTON, Calif. — Simpson Strong-Tie, the leader in engineered structural connectors and building solutions, and hsbcad, a leading global provider of design, manufacturing and assembly software solutions for offsite timber construction, are bringing advanced digital wall-framing capabilities to component manufacturers through CS Cornerstone™ Wall software, powered by hsbcad technology. Available since June 2026, CS Cornerstone Wall software combines building modeling with structural wood-component design and analysis. The solution will be demonstrated during the Building Component Manufacturers Conference (BCMC), September 14–18, in Columbus, Ohio, at Simpson Strong-Tie Booth 901, with hsbcad also exhibiting at Booth 113. The collaboration brings hsbcad’s established wall-framing technology into the IntelliCAD environment, giving IntelliCAD designers and manufacturers access to the same powerful wall-framing capabilities behind hsbcad’s hsbDesign for Revit® and AutoCAD® solutions. At the core of the solution are hsbcad’s parametric detailing technology, configurable framing styles and framing engine, enabling detailed, production-ready wall models to be created more efficiently. “What makes this especially valuable is the amount of repetitive work we can take out of the process. Parametric details adapt automatically as wall dimensions, angles or timber sizes change, while framing styles let manufacturers define their preferred configurations once and apply them consistently across multiple walls. That means less manual detailing and a more reliable path from design to production,” said Kris Riemslagh, technology architect at hsbcad. The technology behind CS Cornerstone Wall software builds on multiple generations of hsbcad wall-detailing development and its experience supporting timber manufacturers around the world. “This collaboration is about bringing together complementary expertise to give manufacturers better tools for the way they design and build today,” said Hilde Sevens, CEO of hsbcad. “Together with Simpson Strong-Tie, we’re making our proven technology accessible to a broader part of the industry and helping move timber construction toward more connected, efficient and sustainable ways of working.” The collaboration also extends beyond wall modeling. CS Cornerstone Wall software customers benefit from additional hsbcad technologies that support downstream workflows, including hsbView, which provides access to digital shop drawings and production information, and hsbcad’s validation technology, which applies configurable, rule-based checks to help ensure models meet design, structural and production requirements, such as stud spacing, sheathing edge support and nail-line requirements. For manufacturers looking to connect digital models further into production, hsbcad’s exporters can support the transfer of manufacturing data to leading CNC machines and shop-floor environments. Simpson Strong-Tie also serves as an hsbcad reseller for selected machine-connectivity solutions, extending the relationship between the two companies beyond the CS Cornerstone Wall software platform. At BCMC 2026, attendees will be able to see CS Cornerstone Wall software alongside the broader Simpson Strong-Tie® Component Solutions® software and equipment portfolio. Highlights at Simpson Strong-Tie Booth 901 will include: · CS Cornerstone™ Wall software: The new all-in-one platform combines building modeling with structural wood-component design and analysis, powered by hsbcad. · CS Cloud Director™: The new cloud-based management platform is designed to improve visibility, streamline operations and support profitability. Schedule a live demo to experience these innovations and the full suite of Component Solutions® software. · CS® Producer™ truss production management software: The newest addition to the Component Solutions® software suite, this cutting-edge, cloud-based software gives floor and roof truss manufacturers powerful ways to schedule and manage daily operations. · Happy hour: Join the Simpson Strong-Tie team for happy hour on Wednesday, September 16, from 6 p.m. to 9 p.m. at Stories on High rooftop bar. Highlights at hsbcad Booth 113 will include: · hsbDesign for Revit® and AutoCAD®: See hsbcad’s latest timber design and detailing capabilities for creating detailed, production-ready models. · hsbMake: Explore hsbcad’s CAM/MES solution for managing and optimizing production on the shop floor, including CNC machine connectivity. · Sign up for hsbNext 2026: For those interested in exploring hsbcad’s wall-framing technology and developments further, hsbNext 2026 will feature two live online sessions focused on design and production, taking place on September 17 and September 21, respectively. Attendees can register for free online and learn more at the booth: https://bit.ly/hsbNext2026. · Meet the team: Connect with Randy Laplante and Jared Flores from hsbcad’s North America team to discuss how hsbcad technology can support your design and production workflows. About Simpson Strong-Tie Company Inc. Simpson Strong-Tie is the world leader in structural solutions — products and technology that help people design and build safer, stronger homes, buildings and communities. As a pioneer in the building industry, we have an unmatched passion for problem solving through skilled engineering and thoughtful innovation. Our structural systems research and rigorous testing enable us to design code-listed, value-engineered solutions for a variety of applications in wood, steel and concrete structures. Our dedication to pursuing ever-better construction products and technology and to surrounding our customers with exceptional service and support has been core to our mission since 1956. For more information, visit strongtie.com and follow us on Facebook, X, YouTube and LinkedIn. About hsbcad With more than 35 years of experience, hsbcad develops software solutions that connect design, manufacturing and assembly for the offsite timber industry. Its solutions automate framing, generate production-ready data, drive CNC machinery and support manufacturing operations, helping manufacturers reduce manual work, improve accuracy and shorten project lead times. Driven by its purpose, “We reshape today’s construction industry into a sustainable and innovative tomorrow,” hsbcad develops technology that helps offsite manufacturers work more efficiently and make better use of materials and data. Headquartered in Ghent, Belgium, hsbcad has a global team of more than 80 people across subsidiaries in Germany, the Netherlands, the U.K., the U.S., Canada, Japan, Ecuador and Australia. For more information, visit www.hsbcad.com.

articles.summary: 09/08/26 Simpson Strong-Tie Joins the Lowes Building Futures Skilled Trades Coalition to Help Strengthen America's Construction Workforce PLEASANTON, Calif., Sept. 1, 2026 – Simpson Strong-Tie, the leader in engineered structural connectors and building solutions, announced it has joined the Building Futures Skilled Trades Coalition as a founding member, partnering with more than 75 organizations committed to helping train and develop one million people for skilled trades careers by 2035. The coalition, launched by the Lowe's Foundation, brings together educators, businesses, workforce organizations and industry leaders to address one of America's most pressing workforce challenges. The United States could face as many as 2.1 million unfilled skilled trades positions by 2030, creating significant impacts across the construction and broader economy. For Simpson Strong-Tie, supporting the next generation of skilled trade professionals aligns with the company's mission and values. Every day, contractors, builders, framers, installers, and other construction professionals rely on skilled craftsmanship to create safe, resilient structures and strong communities. As demand for housing, infrastructure and resilient construction grows, developing a skilled workforce is critical to the future of the building industry. “Skilled tradespeople are essential to the homes, buildings and infrastructure our communities depend on every day,” said Mike Olosky, president and CEO of Simpson Strong-Tie. “Expanding pathways into the trades will help develop the next generation of skilled workers, meet future demand and support the long-term growth of the construction industry. At Simpson Strong-Tie, we help create those pathways by investing in hands-on training, certification programs, mentorship and employee engagement initiatives that connect more people with rewarding careers in the skilled trades.” The coalition will focus on three key priorities: changing perceptions of skilled trades careers, connecting and scaling proven training and credentialing solutions, and measuring progress from training to employment. Coalition members will share knowledge, identify successful approaches and work together to expand access to rewarding career opportunities across the skilled trades. Simpson Strong-Tie brings decades of experience supporting the construction industry through innovation, education and partnerships that help professionals build safer, stronger structures. Through participation in the coalition, the company will collaborate with organizations across the skilled trades ecosystem to help address workforce challenges and strengthen the talent pipeline for the future. The Building Futures Skilled Trades Coalition is the nation's largest cross-sector skilled trades coalition and includes more than 75 founding members representing businesses, educators, workforce organizations and industry stakeholders. articles.summary: 09/16/26 Simpson Strong-Tie Expands Outdoor Accents Decorative Hardware Line with New Button-Head Connector Screw PLEASANTON, Calif. — September 16, 2026— Simpson Strong-Tie, the leader in engineered structural connectors and building solutions, today announced the launch of the Outdoor Accents® button-head connector screw, a new fastener designed to help pros and DIYers complete outdoor living projects with strength, style and efficiency. Designed for use with Outdoor Accents decorative hardware, the new patent-pending screw features a low-profile button head that delivers a clean, finished appearance while helping installers create attractive wood connections for pergolas, patio covers, decks, fences and other outdoor structures. Its stylish, one-piece design is simple to install and offers an engineered alternative to the bolted look of the Outdoor Accents structural wood screw and hex-head combo. "Consumers continue to invest in outdoor living spaces that reflect the same attention to detail and design found inside the home," said Scott Park, Director, Product Development - Connectors, Lateral, and Steel. "The Outdoor Accents button-head connector screw provides a decorative fastening solution that complements the overall look of a project, helping builders and homeowners achieve a refined, modern appearance with details that make a lasting impression." The Outdoor Accents button-head connector screw is engineered to install Outdoor Accents structural connectors in the Mission Collection® and Avant Collection™. The button-head screw features an innovative under-head cone-shaped geometry that is specifically sized to fill the holes on Outdoor Accents connectors. Its black double-barrier coating gives a premium look, while providing exterior-grade corrosion resistance. Key features include: · Button-head design for a clean, decorative finished look · Compatible styling with Outdoor Accents decorative hardware · Black finish that complements outdoor wood connections · Ideal for visible fastening applications in outdoor living projects · Designed for pros and DIYers seeking both performance and curb appeal The new screw expands the Outdoor Accents offering and gives installers another option for creating strong, attractive connections in outdoor living spaces. From backyard upgrades to larger structural wood projects, Outdoor Accents products are designed to help make it easier to build with confidence and achieve a professional-looking finish. The Outdoor Accents button-head connector screw is now available through select Simpson Strong-Tie distributors and retailers. For more information, visit strongtie.com/buttonhead.
